name: for and case always go on several lines
render, include, section and friends
a tag that is not known, and one that is not understood
the liquid tag
source:
{% liquid
assign a = 1
    if a == 1
echo 'one'
  elsif a
    echo 'two'
        endif

  # a comment
  for i in (1..3)
    render 'x', i: i
  endfor
  case a
    when 1
      echo 'x'
  endcase
%}
